description: Rename or restyle a Memo deck, or change its front/back language. Only fields you pass change. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

back_lang.description: BCP-47 language of the back side. Empty string clears it.

front_lang.description: BCP-47 language of the front side. Empty string clears it.

name: update_memo_deck
